name: stochastic_respiratory_cycle_jitter
mechanism: Replaces a fixed periodic respiratory envelope with cycle-by-cycle stochastic variation by independently sampling inspiration, expiration, and pause durations for each breath.

name: add_low_frequency_body_rumble
mechanism: Introduces a dominant low-frequency body rumble below 100 Hz to the noise floor to simulate the acoustic environment of an electronic stethoscope and anchor the zero-crossing rate.
code_snippet: b_r, a_r = signal.butter(2, 100, btype='lowpass', fs=SR); body_rumble = signal.filtfilt(b_r, a_r, rumble_white)

name: narrow_crackle_frequency_band
mechanism: Lowers the upper cutoff frequency of the bandpass filter applied to crackle bursts from 1000 Hz to 500 Hz to reduce unnatural high-frequency transients.

name: dry_wet_transient_preservation
mechanism: Mixing a bandpass-filtered signal with a fraction of the original unfiltered signal to preserve broadband transient characteristics.

name: add_harmonics_to_oscillator
mechanism: Adds a first harmonic to the base sine wave during signal generation to produce a more realistic, less synthetic timbre.
code_snippet: w_sine = np.sin(2 * np.pi * phase_acc) + 0.4 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * phase_acc)

name: enrich_wheeze_harmonics
mechanism: Added an additional harmonic and increased the amplitude of the first harmonic to create a richer, less synthetic wheeze timbre.
code_snippet: w_sine = (np.sin(2 * np.pi * phase_acc) + 0.3 * np.sin(4 * np.pi * phase_acc) + 0.1 * np.sin(6 * np.pi * phase_acc))
